hiv.definition: n. infection by the human immunodeficiency virus
hiv.translation: abbr. 艾滋病病毒（human immunodeficiency virus）

hiv-1.translation: 人类免疫缺陷病毒1型（human immunodeficiency virus-1）

hiv-2.translation: n. 【细菌学、免疫学】人体免疫缺损病毒2号, 艾滋病病毒—2

hive.definition:
n. a teeming multitude
v. store, like bees
v. move together in a hive or as if in a hive
v. gather into a hive
hive.translation:
n. 蜂房, 闹区, 蜜蜂群
vi. 进入蜂房, 储藏蜜于蜂房, 如蜂般群居
vt. 使进蜂房, 储备
[计] 蜂巢

hived.translation: v. 使（蜂）入蜂箱( hive的过去式和过去分词 ); （蜂）进入蜂箱; 把一部份分离出来, 卖掉公司的一部分

hiver.definition: n. One who collects bees into a hive.

hives.definition:
n an itchy skin eruption characterized by weals with pale interiors and well-defined red margins; usually the result of an allergic response to insect bites or food or drugs
n a teeming multitude
n a man-made receptacle that houses a swarm of bees
n a structure that provides a natural habitation for bees; as in a hollow tree
v store, like bees
v move together in a hive or as if in a hive
v gather into a hive
hives.translation:
n. 荨麻疹
[医] 荨麻疹

hiving.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Hive
hiving.translation: v. 使（蜂）入蜂箱( hive的现在分词 ); （蜂）进入蜂箱; 把一部份分离出来, 卖掉公司的一部分
